section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the International Cognitive Ability Resource (ICAR60), a public-domain measure of cognitive ability. It details the 60 items, which include matrix reasoning, verbal reasoning, letter–number series, and three-dimensional rotation items. The ICAR60 is presented as a validated brief measure for construct-level evaluations of cognitive ability, not as a substitute for extended one-on-one assessments.
